selection: Filter original audited pool by previous target/reference/smoke IDs and question hashes; hash round-robin select eight from remaining18
reference: deterministic first distinct-image candidate; SCOPE_UNKNOWN, not verified BG/NEAR
teacher: Independent clean FP32 functional and native BF16 Base teachers
target_rule: min(max(clean native BF16 score, clean functional FP32 score)+0.1,-1e-4)

native_regression.inputs: the two permanently reserved mechanical rows

checkpoint_lifecycle: export accepted matrix, clean native reload/generation parity then delete exact temporary matrix; rejected weights restore Base
historical_control: E16 all eight cases exact numeric trajectories and mechanical fingerprint
hypothesis: Positive batched teacher-forced target margins can coexist with native greedy failure because batch/sequence execution or generation processing changes near-tied logits; separate comparisons can localize the mismatch
primary: Per-target-token batched teacher-forced margin, singleton teacher-forced margin, independent native target-prefix next-token processed score margin, explicit-mask next-token scores; target argmax and max vector differences
changed_scientific_field: No optimization or acceptance change; read-only diagnostic comparisons before/after E16 exact replay
secondary: trial numerical decomposition, native-functional parity, cost and memory

generation.decoding: native mistral_instruct; generated suffix length from decoding scores
generation.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, remove Unicode punctuation, collapse whitespace; retain articles and negation
generation.token_F1: whitespace token multiset overlap; empty prediction score zero
generation.truncated: 64 generated tokens without EOS, retain in all denominators
generation.scope: Original target train-answer lexical match, not independent clinical or new-fact editing accuracy
generation.raw_outputs: Private tokens, decoded text, reference for before and after; publish aggregate metrics only
generation.clean_reload: 64-token answer diagnostic must match exactly in independent native consumer

diagnostic_probes.selection: All eligible source-hash-ordered original train candidates, excluding target/reference/smoke IDs and question hashes
diagnostic_probes.metrics_dtype: CPU FP32 log probabilities from native BF16 logits

stop: Any initial control/mechanical replay mismatch, native consumer failure, nonfinite metric or resource cap; retain full evidence and cumulative costs

target_objective.name: minimum_token_margin
target_objective.positions: all nonmasked target content labels plus EOS
target_objective.competitor: best vocabulary token other than target at each teacher-forced position
target_objective.optimizer: Same functional QP, stochastic BF16 rounding seed20261002, native-value RHS,6steps,16CG,trust radius0.1,drift limits0.3,referenceKL0.001
target_objective.prompt: original unmodified prompt; E13 short suffix not used
target_objective.likelihood: Report mean answer logprob separately; legacy base_score/threshold/final_deployed_score are now logit-margin units for scientific cases
target_objective.greedy_validation: Numerical margin acceptance never substitutes for actual generated target tokens including EOS and independent reload

numerical_control.numerical_success: Report all solver failures and CG receipts; E15 had one primal KKT failure despite converged CG. This is not a new tolerance experiment.

control.mechanical_regression: Unchanged mean-logprob functional branch with exact E11 fingerprint; outside scientific denominator
control.satisfaction: At least2/8 previously non-exact cases must produce the exact target-token sequence including EOS after an accepted physical edit; no probe score decrease below-0.1; all required native consumers must pass. Otherwise criterion fails. This is developmental original-answer reinforcement, not clinical new-fact editing.
control.no_silent_relaxation: Six-step E16 optimizer/thresholds unchanged; exact full replay required. Diagnostic calls never feed optimizer or acceptance.

diagnostic.target_prefix_positions: All content labels plus EOS, at most64; teacher-forced prefixes are supplied independently, not treated as actual cached continuation after divergence
comparisons: singleton teacher versus one-step native generation scores on identical target prefix
implicit versus explicit all-one prefix attention mask
diagnostic.argmax_change: Report any target/non-target greedy disagreement regardless of threshold
diagnostic.qualification: All8 exact E16 edit trajectories, native controls and all required consumers pass; this qualifies diagnosis only, not editing efficacy
diagnostic.interpretation: Processed generation scores and teacher-forced logits are different observations; a difference does not alone prove which internal kernel/cache/logits processor causes it
